age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 64 years. For Ex-Servicemen, duration of engagement shall be 05 years or till 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.

qualification.details: Assistant Technical Consultant: ITI passed and must possess National Trade Certificate (NTC) in Electrician trade. Experience: Minimum 15 years post qualification experience in field of testing of higher rating Power Transformers up to 400 KV class with fully assembled final testing as well as stage testing, knowledge of testing equipment/ Instrument, test connections and fault-finding OR Minimum 15 years post qualification experience in field of Locomotive assembly, operational knowledge testing equipment/ Instrument, test connections, fault-finding and trouble shooting and having experience of erection and commissioning of diesel electric shunting locomotive at site.

salary_details.details: Consolidated fee of Rs. 40,000/- per month. Mobile phone charges (Up to Rs 2000) for one connection. HRA as per applicable rates. Transport allowance at 10% of consultancy fee.

selection_process: Applications received against the Notification will be scrutinized by a Committee and shortlisted candidates may be then called for an interaction
by a duly constituted Selection Board. Outstation candidates called for interaction shall be reimbursed the travel expenses by the shortest route as given below: By Rail : AC -II Sleeper
By Road : Actuals limited to Train fare of AC-II Sleeper
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for BHEL Assistant Technical Consultants Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:bhel.com .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BHEL Assistant Technical Consultants Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 25th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any postal delays.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Technical Consultants post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI and possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) in the Electrician trade to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Assistant Technical Consultants at BHEL?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Technical Consultants post is 64 years. Specific relaxations are available for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Technical Consultants?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Assistant Technical Consultants in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Technical Consultants position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated fee of Rs. 40,000/- per month, along with mobile charges, HRA, and transport allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required experience for the Assistant Technical Consultants post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of post-qualification experience in testing of Power Transformers or Locomotive assembly is required, as detailed in the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be any interaction or interview for selection?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates may be called for an interaction if required by a duly constituted Selection Board.

faq.question: Q9. Are travel expenses reimbursed for the interaction?
faq.answer: Yes, outstation candidates called for interaction will be reimbursed travel expenses by the shortest route, as per the specified norms.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to Sr. Engineer (Rectt., Canteen, NIC & CPIO) HRM Department, Administrative Building, BHEL- Jhansi Unit, Khailar-Jhansi (UP)- 284120.
